facts.fact: The study's baseline for the eight primary health centres in the Sinfra and Bouaflé health districts (the abstract says sixteen) was taken from paper registries and paper-based patient records covering August 2021 to February 2022 (1,129 baseline patients), according to the authors of this medRxiv preprint; the statement covers the study sites only.

systems.platform: eSkinHealth app (version 1.2.8) on tablets, offline entry synchronised to an iCloud server
systems.owner: research project (Hope Commission International, Tulane University and partners, with district health authorities and the national leprosy and Buruli ulcer programmes among the authors)
systems.tiers: eight primary health centres in the Sinfra and Bouaflé health districts, used by nurses and community health workers, August 2022 to February 2023

note: eSkinHealth is a patient-level record and teledermatology tool for skin diseases only, a research intervention at study sites (class tracker), so it gives no fact; the one fact is the dated paper position at the study sites.
